node.statement: For A in B_r^{icalH}(0), lem-stage1-unitary-graph-control gives U=chi_s(A) in calU. Put W=sigma(U) and Q=h_delta(U^dagger)-J for the same synchronized polar inverse. Then W is in calU, Q is Hermitian with ||Q||<delta, U^dagger=W bold-dot(J+Q), and all depend C1 on A; lem-stage1-explicit-group-closeness for this same u_delta gives ||W-U^dagger||<=G_c*epsilon_r.
